name: LSP Hover Documentation
desc: Open documentation / type signature for the symbol under cursor in a floating window.
detail: Press 'K' while on any function, variable, class, or keyword to see its documentation, parameters, and return type. Press 'K' a second time to jump into the documentation float to scroll through it with j/k, then press 'q' or <Esc> to exit.
keywords: doc docs documentation lsp hover type info signature help quick

name: Open Diagnostic Quickfix / Loclist
desc: Opens the location list / quickfix window populated with current buffer diagnostics.
detail: Leader is Space. Press <Space>q to open the quickfix window showing all errors and warnings in the current file. Navigate entries with j/k, press <CR> to jump to an error, and close the window with :lclose or :q.
keywords: quick quickfix loclist diagnostics errors warnings lint window list

name: Jump to Prev / Next Diagnostic
desc: Jump between errors and warnings, automatically opening a floating error detail popup.
detail: Press ']d' to jump to the next diagnostic error/warning or '[d' for the previous one. Your config automatically pops up a rounded floating window displaying the full error message without having to hover.
keywords: diagnostic next prev error jump warning float popup

name: Trigger Completion & Docs Popup
desc: Open the completion menu or toggle the documentation preview window for the active item.
detail: While typing in Insert mode, press Ctrl+Space to force open the autocomplete menu. If the menu is already open, pressing Ctrl+Space opens the documentation side-panel explaining the highlighted candidate.
keywords: autocomplete cmp completion doc docs documentation signature blink

name: Accept Autocompletion
desc: Accept the highlighted completion candidate ([y]es).
detail: In Insert mode, accepts the highlighted item. Automatically adds import statements if the LSP supports auto-import, and expands snippet placeholders.
keywords: accept completion yes enter tab blink import

name: Toggle Signature Help
desc: Toggle the floating signature window displaying parameter types as you type function arguments.
detail: Shows the expected arguments and types for the function call you are currently writing.
keywords: signature help parameters arguments lsp function blink

name: Jump Snippet Placeholders
desc: Jump forward (<Tab>) or backward (<S-Tab>) through snippet placeholders.
detail: When a snippet is expanded (like creating a method or class), use Tab to jump to the next parameter placeholder and Shift+Tab to jump back.
keywords: snippet luasnip tab placeholder expand template

name: LSP Goto Definition
desc: Jump to where the variable, function, or class under cursor was defined.
detail: Opens definition using Telescope. If multiple definitions exist, Telescope lets you pick. Press <C-t> to jump back to where you were before!
keywords: definition goto jump lsp source declaration back ctrl-t

name: LSP Goto References
desc: Search for all references to the symbol under cursor across your whole project.
detail: Opens a Telescope picker listing every file and line where the symbol is referenced. Filter by typing, press <CR> to jump.
keywords: references find usages where used lsp telescope

name: LSP Goto Implementation
desc: Jump to concrete implementations of an interface or abstract method.
detail: Essential for languages like Java, Go, and TypeScript. Opens Telescope picker if multiple classes implement the method.
keywords: implementation interface abstract class lsp goto

name: LSP Goto Type Definition
desc: Jump to the definition of a variable's *type* rather than where the variable itself was instantiated.
detail: Useful when inspecting a variable and you want to jump directly to its class / struct / interface definition.
keywords: type definition struct class interface lsp

name: LSP Rename Symbol
desc: Safely rename the symbol under cursor across the entire workspace.
detail: Prompts for a new name and updates all occurrences across all files in your project according to semantic LSP rules.
keywords: rename refactor symbol variable function class lsp

name: LSP Code Actions
desc: Show available code actions (quick-fixes, auto-imports, refactorings).
detail: Move cursor over an error or warning, or select a block of code in Visual mode, and press 'gra'. Select from available fixes or transformations.
keywords: code action quickfix fix import refactor lightbulb lsp

name: Document Symbols Outline
desc: Fuzzy find functions, classes, and variables in the current buffer via Telescope.
detail: Provides an instant outline of the current file. Filter by typing method or variable names to jump directly to them.
keywords: symbols document outline methods functions classes telescope

name: Workspace Symbols Search
desc: Fuzzy find all symbols across your entire workspace/project via Telescope.
detail: Search classes, methods, constants across all project files without having to open the file first.
keywords: workspace symbols project classes methods functions telescope

name: Toggle Inlay Hints
desc: Toggle inline parameter name and inferred type hints on/off.
detail: Press <Space>th. If your LSP server supports inlay hints, toggles inline parameter names (e.g. 'title: ' or 'count: ') directly in your code buffer.
keywords: inlay hints parameters types toggle lsp

name: Format Buffer / Selection
desc: Format the entire buffer or selected visual range via conform.nvim.
detail: Press <Space>f. Uses your configured formatters (stylua, Java LSP formatter, prettier, etc.) asynchronously.
keywords: format formatting conform stylua prettier indent lint

name: Search Files
desc: Fuzzy search files by name in current project (respects .gitignore).
detail: Press <Space>sf. Type any part of a file name or path. Press <CR> to open, <C-v> to open in vertical split, <C-x> to open in horizontal split.
keywords: find search files find_files telescope open filename

name: Search All Files (incl. Hidden & Ignored)
desc: Fuzzy search all files, including dotfiles and files in .gitignore.
detail: Press <Space>SF. Searches files that normal file search ignores (e.g. .env, build output, dotfiles).
keywords: hidden ignored gitignore dotfiles find files search telescope

name: Live Grep
desc: Search for text contents across all files in project via ripgrep.
detail: Press <Space>sg. Type words or phrases to search text inside all files in real time. Press <CR> to jump to the match.
keywords: grep search text ripgrep find content live_grep telescope

name: Live Grep All (incl. Hidden & Ignored)
desc: Live grep across all files, including gitignored and hidden files.
detail: Press <Space>SG. Useful when searching in vendor files, logs, or .gitignore'd source directories.
keywords: grep all hidden ignored gitignore ripgrep telescope

name: Search Word Under Cursor
desc: Grep for the word currently under your cursor (or visual selection) across all files.
detail: Press <Space>sw on any word or identifier. In visual mode, greps for the exact highlighted text.
keywords: search word grep cursor selection telescope

name: Fuzzy Search Current Buffer
desc: Fuzzily search lines inside the currently active buffer (dropdown theme).
detail: Press <Space>/ to open a sleek popup dropdown. Type words to find matching lines in the current file instantly.
keywords: search buffer current find lines dropdown telescope

name: Live Grep in Open Files
desc: Live grep search restricted only to currently open buffers.
detail: Press <Space>s/. Searches contents across files you have already opened rather than entire disk.
keywords: grep open buffers files telescope

name: Find Existing Buffers
desc: Browse and switch between all currently open editor buffers.
detail: Press <Space><Space>. Type to filter open tabs/buffers and press <CR> to switch to it.
keywords: buffers switch open tabs telescope list

name: Search Recent Files
desc: Search recently opened files (oldfiles).
detail: Press <Space>s. to quickly jump back to files you edited in previous sessions.
keywords: recent oldfiles history files telescope

name: Search Diagnostics
desc: Search all errors, warnings, and hints across the entire workspace.
detail: Press <Space>sd to view a project-wide error list. Filter by error message, severity, or filename.
keywords: diagnostics errors warnings lint workspace telescope

name: Search Keymaps
desc: Fuzzy search all registered key combinations and commands in Neovim.
detail: Press <Space>sk. Search any key or description to see what it is mapped to and what plugin created it.
keywords: keymaps keys bindings shortcuts search telescope

name: Search Help Documentation
desc: Fuzzy search Neovim's official :help documentation tags.
detail: Press <Space>sh. Search any Vim concept, command, or plugin name (e.g. 'lsp', 'treesitter', 'wincmd').
keywords: help doc documentation tags manual guide telescope

name: Search Commands
desc: Fuzzy search and execute Neovim user commands and builtin commands.
detail: Press <Space>sc. Shows commands with descriptions; press <CR> to execute.
keywords: commands execute run telescope

name: Select Telescope Builtin Pickers
desc: Browse and launch any of Telescope's built-in pickers.
detail: Press <Space>ss to discover all available pickers in Telescope.
keywords: select telescope builtins pickers list

name: Resume Last Telescope Search
desc: Re-open your previous Telescope search with the exact query and selection preserved.
detail: Press <Space>sr if you accidentally closed a search or need to pick another item from the same list.
keywords: resume previous last search telescope

name: Search Neovim Config Files
desc: Fuzzy find files inside your ~/.config/nvim configuration folder.
detail: Press <Space>sn to quickly open any config file (init.lua, custom plugins, etc.).
keywords: config neovim nvim files dotfiles telescope

name: Toggle File Tree (NvimTree)
desc: Toggle NvimTree sidebar and automatically locate/reveal the current file.
detail: Press the backslash key '\'. NvimTree opens on the left with the current file highlighted. In NvimTree: <CR> opens file, 'a' creates new file/folder, 'd' deletes, 'r' renames, 'q' closes.
keywords: tree explorer files sidebar nvimtree find reveal toggle

name: Navigate Window Splits
desc: Seamlessly switch focus between window splits without pressing <C-w> first.
detail: Ctrl+h moves to left window, Ctrl+j moves to window below, Ctrl+k moves to window above, Ctrl+l moves to right window. New splits can be created with :split (<C-w>s) and :vsplit (<C-w>v).
keywords: split window navigate focus left right up down ctrl-w

name: Clear Search Highlights
desc: Clear yellow highlight marks from previous searches (:nohlsearch).
detail: Press <Esc> in Normal mode to instantly remove search highlight colors after searching with / or ?.
keywords: clear search highlight nohlsearch esc

name: Safe Visual Paste
desc: Paste over a visual selection without replacing your clipboard with the deleted text.
detail: In normal Vim, pasting over text replaces your register with the deleted text. In your config, visual 'p' uses '"_dP', so your copied text remains intact in clipboard for multiple pastes!
keywords: paste visual clipboard register safe replace

name: Universal Floating Terminal
desc: Toggle a floating terminal overlay from normal or terminal mode.
detail: Press Ctrl+\ anywhere to pop up a floating terminal window with TokyoNight styling. Press Ctrl+\ again to dismiss it without killing your running process.
keywords: terminal float toggleterm shell bash popup

name: Toggle Float Terminal #1
desc: Toggle persistent floating terminal session #1.
detail: Press Ctrl+t in normal or terminal mode. This terminal has ID 1 and stays running in the background when hidden.
keywords: terminal float 1 toggleterm persistent

name: Toggle Float Terminal #2
desc: Toggle persistent floating terminal session #2 (Alt+t).
detail: Press Alt+t (Meta+t) to open a separate, independent terminal session (ID 2). Run servers in one terminal and shell commands in the other!
keywords: terminal float 2 alt-t toggleterm second

name: Exit Terminal Insert Mode
desc: Switch from terminal interactive mode back to Neovim Normal mode (<C-\><C-n>).
detail: Double-tap <Esc> inside any terminal window to enter normal mode so you can scroll output, copy text with y, or switch windows with <C-h/j/k/l>.
keywords: terminal exit normal scroll copy mode

name: LazyGit Interface
desc: Open the full LazyGit floating TUI directly inside Neovim.
detail: Press <Space>gg. Opens LazyGit in a centered floating window. Stage, unstage, commit, branch, merge, rebase. Opening a file from LazyGit seamlessly opens it in your Neovim buffer!
keywords: git lazygit tui commit branch stage status push pull

name: Git Worktrees
desc: Pick a git worktree and jump to its own Neovim in its own kitty tab.
detail: Press <Space>gw. Lists the repo's worktrees (● = current). Enter focuses the kitty tab already running Neovim in that worktree, or opens a new tab titled repo:branch. Your current Neovim keeps running in the background with its buffers, LSP and debugger. In LazyGit's Worktrees panel, press o to do the same.
keywords: git worktree switch branch kitty tab background lazygit

name: Next / Prev Git Hunk
desc: Jump cursor to next (']c') or previous ('[c') git modification hunk.
detail: Quickly jump through code changes in the active buffer. Automatically respects vim diff mode if active.
keywords: git hunk change next prev diff gitsigns

name: Stage Git Hunk
desc: Stage the git change hunk under cursor (or visually selected lines).
detail: Press <Space>hs in normal mode to stage the hunk under cursor. In visual mode, stages precisely the selected lines into git index.
keywords: git stage hunk gitsigns index

name: Reset / Discard Git Hunk
desc: Revert/discard changes in the current git hunk (or visually selected lines).
detail: Press <Space>hr to revert the hunk back to the last committed state.
keywords: git reset revert discard hunk undo gitsigns

name: Stage / Reset Entire Buffer
desc: <Space>hS stages all changes in current buffer; <Space>hR discards all changes.
detail: Fast staging or reverting of an entire file.
keywords: git stage buffer reset revert all gitsigns

name: Preview Git Hunk (Popup / Inline)
desc: <Space>hp opens a floating diff popup of the hunk; <Space>hi toggles inline diff.
detail: Review changes without opening an external diff tool.
keywords: git preview popup inline diff hunk gitsigns

name: Git Blame Line
desc: Open a detailed floating window with git blame, author, commit hash, date, message.
detail: Press <Space>hb on any line to inspect who wrote it and the full commit message.
keywords: git blame author commit date message gitsigns

name: Git Diff Split (Index / Last Commit)
desc: <Space>hd diffs against git index (staged); <Space>hD diffs against HEAD (@).
detail: Opens a side-by-side Vim diff view.
keywords: git diff split staged head compare gitsigns

name: Git Hunks Quickfix List
desc: <Space>hq populates quickfix with hunks in this file; <Space>hQ with all hunks in repo.
detail: Turn all code changes into a quickfix checklist you can step through with :cnext and :cprev.
keywords: git hunks quickfix list all repo file gitsigns

name: Toggle Git Blame / Word Diff
desc: <Space>tb toggles virtual text blame at end of line; <Space>tw toggles intra-line word diff.
detail: Instant visual toggles for reviewing changes directly in the code.
keywords: git toggle blame word diff virtual text gitsigns

name: Debugger: Start / Resume
desc: Start debugging session or resume execution until the next breakpoint.
detail: Matches IntelliJ keybinding (F9). If no session is running, starts the debugger; if stopped at a breakpoint, resumes running.
keywords: debug debugger dap start resume continue f9 f5

name: Debugger: Step Over
desc: Step to the next line of code without entering function calls (IntelliJ F8).
detail: Executes the current line and pauses at the next line.
keywords: debug step over next f8 dap

name: Debugger: Step Into
desc: Step into the function call at the current line (IntelliJ F7).
detail: Enters the called method or function definition.
keywords: debug step into inside function f7 dap

name: Debugger: Step Out
desc: Step out of the current function to its caller (IntelliJ Shift+F8 / F20).
detail: Finishes execution of the current function and returns to the line where it was invoked.
keywords: debug step out finish return shift-f8 dap

name: Debugger: Run to Cursor
desc: Continue execution directly until reaching the cursor's line (IntelliJ Alt+F9).
detail: Positions cursor on desired line and continues execution without needing a permanent breakpoint.
keywords: debug run to cursor alt-f9 dap

name: Toggle Breakpoint
desc: Toggle breakpoint on the current line (IntelliJ Ctrl+F8 or <Space>b).
detail: Places or removes a breakpoint sign on the current line.
keywords: debug breakpoint toggle ctrl-f8 leader-b dap

name: Conditional Breakpoint
desc: Set a breakpoint with a custom condition expression.
detail: Prompts: 'Breakpoint condition: '. The debugger will only pause if the expression evaluates to true (e.g. i == 100).
keywords: debug conditional breakpoint condition expr dap

name: Evaluate Expression
desc: Evaluate the expression or variable under cursor in a floating inspector.
detail: IntelliJ Alt+F8 or <Space>de. Opens a popup displaying the evaluated runtime value.
keywords: debug evaluate expression inspect hover alt-f8 dap

name: Toggle Debug UI Panels
desc: Toggle DAP-UI side panels (scopes, call stack, watches, breakpoints, repl).
detail: Press <Space>du to open or close the debugger side panel view on the left.
keywords: debug dap-ui panels scopes stack watches toggle

name: Toggle Program Output Console
desc: Toggle the bottom program output / logs console split.
detail: Press <Space>dc. Displays stdout/stderr from your running application or debug session (like IntelliJ's Run/Console tab).
keywords: debug console output logs stdout run dapconsole

name: Clear / List Breakpoints
desc: <Space>dx clears all breakpoints; <Space>dl lists all active breakpoints.
detail: Quick management of your breakpoints across the entire project.
keywords: debug breakpoints clear list dap

name: Java: IntelliJ Action Menu
desc: Open IntelliJ-style Java action menu (run, debug, test, rebuild, maven/gradle, JDK).
detail: Press <Space>jj. Provides an interactive menu for running main classes, running JUnit tests (method, class, or pick), managing Maven/Gradle tasks, selecting JDKs, and viewing logs.
keywords: java menu intellij run debug test maven gradle jdtls

name: Java: Version / JDK Picker
desc: Interactive floating JDK picker; detects system JDKs, SDKMAN, and IntelliJ downloads.
detail: Press <Space>jv or run :JavaVersion. Switches project JDK and persists the choice in java-projects.json.
keywords: java version jdk sdkman jvm picker jdtls

name: Java: Spring Profile Selector
desc: Interactive Spring Boot active profile selector.
detail: Press <Space>jp or run :SpringProfile. Sets SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE for all run, debug, test, and Maven/Gradle launches.
keywords: java spring profile spring-boot active environment

name: Java: Re-run Last Configuration
desc: Re-run the last launched Java main class or configuration (IntelliJ Shift+F10 / F22).
detail: Builds project incrementally before running and streams output to bottom console.
keywords: java rerun rerun-last shift-f10 intellij

name: Java: Debug Main Class
desc: Debug Java main class (IntelliJ Shift+F9 / F21).
detail: Prompts to pick a main class or automatically selects the one in current file.
keywords: java debug main shift-f9 intellij

name: Java: Stop Running App
desc: Stop the running application or active debug session (IntelliJ Ctrl+F2 / F26).
detail: Immediately terminates the debuggee process.
keywords: java stop kill terminate ctrl-f2 intellij

name: Java: Organize Imports
desc: Organize imports in Java file (Alt+o).
detail: Removes unused imports, resolves ambiguous imports, and sorts imports according to Java conventions.
keywords: java organize imports clean unused alt-o jdtls

name: Java: Refactor Extractions
desc: Extract variable ('crv'), constant ('crc'), or method ('crm').
detail: crv extracts expression into variable, crc into static final constant, crm (in visual mode) extracts selected code into a new method.
keywords: java extract variable constant method refactor jdtls

name: Surround Add / Delete / Replace
desc: Surround text with brackets, quotes, or tags using mini.surround.
detail: saiw) = [S]urround [A]dd [I]nner [W]ord with (); sd' = [S]urround [D]elete '; sr)' = [S]urround [R]eplace ) with '.
keywords: surround brackets quotes mini.surround add delete replace

name: Extended Text Objects
desc: Enhanced text objects for selecting, yanking, or changing inside/around delimiters.
detail: va) selects around parens; yiiq yanks inside the next quote on the line; ci' changes inside single quotes; 'aa' / 'ii' target next delimiters.
keywords: textobjects mini.ai visual yank change inner around inside

name: Interactive Documentation & Search
desc: Open interactive searchable documentation directly inside Neovim.
detail: Press <Space>? or run :Doc. Opens an interactive Telescope picker indexing all key combinations, workflows, and Neovim concepts.
keywords: doc docs documentation cheatsheet help search keys interactive
